recovery_implementation.collector: A dependency-injected HTTPS GET client may invoke only the D5 published source URIs. No write endpoint, workflow dispatch, retry, or source outside OscarMackJr/bluto is permitted.
recovery_implementation.persistence: During a fresh authorized run only, write one canonical evidence record per control beneath generated/aa4/runs/{run_id}/evidence/. Before authorization or after expiry, writing must fail closed.
recovery_implementation.orchestration: Validate the issued one-run authorization before the first request; atomically mark it consumed before persistence; make exactly one pass over the 13 controls; never retry automatically.
recovery_implementation.result_persistence: During that same run only, write one governed result per control beneath generated/aa4/runs/{run_id}/results/, binding its evidence SHA-256 and authorization reference.

result_rules.blocked: Access, target, hash, schema, authorization, expiry, or runtime mismatch yields EXECUTION_BLOCKED.
